results.title: China Eximbank provides $480 million loan for China-Laos Railway Project (Linked to Record ID#85304) | AidData Project
results.snippet: In December 2016, Lao-China Railway Company (老中铁路有限公司 or LCRC) — a joint venture between three Chinese state-owned enterprises that collectively hold a 70% ownership stake and one Lao state-owned enterprise that owns a 30% ownership stake — signed a build-operate-transfer (BOT) concession agreement with the Government of Laos for the China-Laos Railway Project.
